notes: Atrium v0.8.0 — The Integration Layer: a local stdio MCP server lets your agents see the whole cockpit and write into it — read project + pane status, read another pane's recent logs (read_pane_output), and add/update TODOs and scratchpad notes — all over the shared filesystem, so it works on default WSL2 with no setup. Plus live per-pane status, context-window usage % on Claude panes, app zoom (Ctrl +/-/0), and first-class agent Providers. Visibility-in, never control-out.
